From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Subject: Discovery recap + proposed rotating demo windows (next steps)

Hi Anna — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposal to get a technical deep dive on the calendar.

Recap (from our notes):
- Top priorities: lower inference cost for batch reports, <200ms p95 latency on user-facing flows, and tighter observability for model rollouts.
- Data footprint: sensitive PHI in docs; interested in Private (VPC) option and KMS integration.
- Decision makers: you (product), Sachin (infra), and your procurement team.

Next step ask: schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive/demo with Ben (solutions engineer) to walk through a small proof-of-concept and latency/cost knobs. Because you have stakeholders across US/EU/APAC, we propose a rotating-week schedule so the meeting time alternates to be friendly to each region. Below are 3 candidate rotating windows (we'd rotate weekly):

Option A (US-friendly week):
- Tue 10:00–11:00 PT / Tue 19:00–20:00 CET / Wed 02:00–03:00 SGT
Option B (EU-friendly week):
- Wed 16:00–17:00 CET / Wed 07:00–08:00 PT / Thu 00:00–01:00 SGT
Option C (APAC-friendly week):
- Thu 09:00–10:00 SGT / Wed 17:00–18:00 PT / Thu 02:00–03:00 CET

If those seem rough, tell us which of the three windows you prefer and which attendees must be present (Sachin? procurement?). We can lock a cadence (weekly or biweekly) and share a rotating calendar series that updates titles with the region-in-focus.

Attached: discovery notes (summary) and a short list of items Ben will demo.

Goal: get a tentative time this week or early next week so Ben can prepare environment-specific examples (quant profiles, caching demo).

Thanks — Rachel

--

Thanks Rachel — helpful recap. Sachin and I reviewed the notes; short answers first: yes to a POC and yes to a rotating slot if that reduces overall calendar pain. A few constraints from our side:

- Procurement will need at least one EU-friendly session during the evaluation week (they're in CET).
- Sachin is only available in late afternoons CET / early mornings PT due to on-call.
- Our product lead prefers not to be on calls past 18:00 CET.

Given that, Option B looks closest but can you shift it 1 hour earlier so it finishes by 17:00 CET? Also, could you propose a biweekly cadence (every other week) for the first two months — we want time to iterate after the POC run.

I can do Wed this coming week (07:00 PT / 16:00 CET / 00:00 SGT) if you can make it 16:00–17:00 CET (so 06:00–07:00 PT for Ben). If early-morning PT is an issue, we can instead target the APAC-friendly week and have Sachin join remotely after his on-call handoff.

Appreciate the flexibility — looping Sachin so he can confirm.

Best,
Anna
